description:
Operator-only: update an existing named Cypher query template.

Same shape as create_query, but the key must already exist. Every field
is replaced with the values given here.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the query returns.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

key.description: Key of the existing query to replace (e.g. 'holdings_by_sector').

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

param_schema.description:
Declared parameters: name -> {"type": string|int|float|
bool|list, "required": true|false, "default": ..., "description": ...}.

name: cypher_update_query
title: Update a query
